title: Validate consequential boundaries before dependent UI slices

rubric.text: Places meaningful persistence/restart, privacy/sanitized-size and async delayed/failure validation in the observable slices establishing those contracts, before dependent UI relies on them.
Requires boundary evidence as explicit UI prerequisites/dependencies; compilation or final-only testing is insufficient, while preserving observable slices and existing settled seams.
Reuses applicable trusted evidence and existing tests; no separate speculative proof for settled contracts and no new consequential-boundary gate for the one-string change.
Treats separate PRs as a planning decision requiring coherent deliverable boundaries and acceptance evidence, not automatic splitting by slices or review count.
Provides a review assessment only and holds missing/failed prerequisite evidence under existing same-owner repair and authority rules.
